selected_text_context.raw_source_excerpt: ''Remercier'' can be used with ''de'' or ''pour''. ''De'' is more common when the complement is an infinitive (''Je te remercie d'avoir pensé à moi''); both are used when the complement is a noun (''Je te remercie pour/de ce beau cadeau''). ''De'' with a noun is sometimes considered more formal, but both are standard.
